p0.title: PATCH /api/bookings/{booking} permission bypass
p0.evidence: Runtime-proven: user without bookings.edit, HTTP 200, status=approved, price=1.00 persisted.
p0.mechanism: apiResource registers PUT and PATCH; the permission-gated Route::put overrides only PUT, so PATCH keeps the apiResource route whose middleware is just ['api','auth:sanctum']. 'status' is an unconstrained string and both 'status' and 'price' are $fillable, written by RescheduleBookingUseCase:135.

p0.title: 19 anonymous /api/v2 routes
p0.evidence: route:list middleware == ['api'] with no Authenticate. Includes anonymous settlement batch write and anonymous payment/ledger/settlement/summary reads.

p0.title: Role/partner admin unpermissioned
p0.evidence: Authenticate present, zero PermissionMiddleware entries. PUT /api/roles/{role}/permissions is direct privilege escalation.

p0.title: APP_DEBUG enabled
p0.evidence: php artisan about: Debug Mode ENABLED.
